name: Ichibatsu 2 Hyakkai
source:
Protagonist decides to play Mahjong again with Akane as his new assistant. This time scene is girls' school with all kind of heroines as opponents. It's an undressing game, and after top and underwear stages there is punishment full voiced stage for each girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角决定与茜作为新助手再次打麻将。这次的场景是女子学校，各种女主角都是对手。这是一场脱衣游戏，在上衣和内衣阶段之后，是对每个女孩的惩罚全声阶段。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
